applicationArchitectureNote: This frontend (src/App.jsx) has no multi-conversation list/browse UI. The single active conversation is tracked via localStorage.tinaConversationId within one authenticated browser session. 'History reopen' for this app means: navigate away and back (or reload) within the same session, which re-fetches GET /conversations/:id/messages and re-hydrates messages via loadConversationMessages/normalizeReloadedTrust. This was validated as designed, not as a gap.

confirmationRun.note: A second, independent conversation (fresh login) was used to regenerate sanitized screenshots after a username-redaction defect was found and fixed in the evidence capture (see security-scan-summary.json). This run independently re-confirms persistence.
